10.specific_limit: Tree canopy can overlie flooded ground; this prediction does not rule out wet understorey.

20.specific_limit: Shrub cover does not establish dry substrate at a particular date.

30.specific_limit: Grass cover can occur on wet or seasonally flooded ground; permanent dryness is not established.

40.specific_limit: Cropland can be seasonally flooded and does not distinguish a dry crop from flooded cultivation.

50.specific_limit: Built-up is the annual producer cover prediction, not a legal parcel, surveyed building or exact developed shoreline.

60.specific_limit: Bare/sparse cover is not a certificate of dry ground at a particular tide/date or a substrate-material identification.

80.specific_limit: The producer permanent-water class models water for more than nine months, fresh or salt. This is not an independent dated persistence measurement, named river/sea, exact bank/thalweg or legal water boundary.
